description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your Marked quarry attempts a reaction (such as an attack of opportunity) against you or your Feral Bond, or spends an action to move adjacent to either of you

The quarry must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or that action is wasted outright — it swings at empty air or moves to the wrong square.

cinderfall.incomplete: Blocked on the Mark, and independently: no rule element retroactively cancels or nullifies an opponent's already-declared action based on a save — confirmed absent across this whole pass's prior sessions (see the guide's "no rule element retroactively redefines an already-rolled die's numeric value" as the closest documented absence of this general category of post-hoc override). The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
